question: What do we know about the generational wealth transfer, and how are these five preparing for it?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James states it seeks to mitigate the risks of departing/retiring financial advisors through financial advisor succession planning and by providing advisors with a broad range of services and resources to support their practices.
items.quote: We seek to mitigate these risks through financial advisor succession planning and by providing our financial advisors with a broad range of services and resources to support their practices.

items.text: Raymond James states that generally, with planned retirements, assets are retained at the firm pursuant to advisor succession plans.
items.quote: Generally, with planned retirements, assets are retained at the firm pursuant to advisor succession plans.

items.text: Raymond James notes that retiring financial advisors without a successor affiliated with the firm may sell their practices to unaffiliated third parties, which is a risk it seeks to mitigate through succession planning.
items.quote: Similarly, retiring financial advisors without a successor affiliated with us may sell their practices to unaffiliated third parties.

items.text: Raymond James states that effective management succession planning is important for the continued success of the firm, and inadequate management succession planning could adversely affect its business.
items.quote: Further, effective management succession planning, is important for the continued success of the firm. Competitive pressures we experience, or inadequate management succession planning, could have an adverse effect on our business, results of operations, financial condition, and liquidity.

items.text: Raymond James states it conducts ongoing and robust succession planning for roles within two levels of its Executive Leadership Team, reviewed with executive leadership and the Board several times per year.
items.quote: We conduct ongoing and robust succession planning for roles that are within two levels of our Executive Leadership Team, and we strive to ensure we have a robust pool of candidates for such roles. We discuss the results with executive leadership and the Board of Directors several times per year.

items.text: Raymond James offers a "Succession and acquisition" offering with specialized guidance to help independent advisors make career-critical decisions, as well as "Succession Planning and Acquisition" resources for RIAs in its RIA & Custody Services division.
items.quote: Succession and acquisition: Make career-critical decisions with specialized guidance

items.text: In its RIA & Custody Services division, Raymond James offers "Succession Planning and Acquisition: Everything you need to plan for your next step and a team of specialists to guide you."
items.quote: Succession Planning and Aquisition: Everything you need to plan for your next step and a team of specialists to guide you

items.text: Raymond James offers loans to prospective financial advisors for recruiting and retention purposes, and had $14 million of unfunded commitments for such loans as of June 30, 2026.
items.quote: We offer loans to prospective financial advisors for recruiting and retention purposes... We had unfunded commitments of $ 14 million for loans to financial advisors who have met such conditions as of June 30, 2026.

items.text: Raymond James noted that the number of financial advisors as of September 30, 2025 increased versus the prior year, as new recruits and trainees moved into production roles exceeded departures and planned retirements.
items.quote: The number of financial advisors as of September 30, 2025 increased compared to the prior year, as new recruits and trainees that were moved into production roles exceeded departures and planned retirements.

cells.reason: Multiple passages directly address advisor succession/retirement planning and how RJF prepares (succession plans retaining assets, succession planning resources, retention loans). These are facts for the sub-question.
